question.text: If the velocity of a body related to displacement <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is given by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>5000</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>24</mn><mi>x</mi></msqrt><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo></math> then the acceleration of the body is _________ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math>

solution.text:
We know that the rate of change of linear velocity is called linear acceleration, a=dvdt=dv×dxdt×dx=vdvdx

⇒a=5000+24x×125000+24x×24=12 m s-2.
